Governing plan: docs/plans/2026-09-20-film-compiler-phase-plan.md
Phase-plan ticket: bd-01M2TAGST4EBFR1HM9Q3EWSYAH
Film parent: bd-01M2T32SGVJXR2RT3RTS2DCN9P

This ticket is an executable child created from the cold-reviewed filing payload. Its blocking edges are authoritative; parent relation is organizational only.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Reuse the existing checked SherlockSourceAtlas and admitted repair record; add checked proposal-surface/chart/origin associations without a second clock or text support surrogate.
2. Preserve annotation hash, repair checksum, ordered part identities and exact native/primary row/scene support through every unit derivation, including unused point row13 and point-only scenes.
3. Wrong part, offset, valid differing rates, excluded mapping image and substituted repair receipt have isolated controls/mutations; complete interval gaps remain preserved.
4. Run the actual compiler on a content-free intake-contract fixture, then a separately receipted authorized local admitted-input association court. Raw annotations/recalls/participant outputs remain ignored.
5. Bind and reuse the complete D1B 1000-row coordinate and all17/2577-row frozen projection evidence; optional legacy scoring coordinates remain feature inputs only. No gold opening or parameter tuning.
6. Separate admitted byte identities from playable-media reachability and report missing external files honestly; do not replace identities to make a court run.

Required gates:
- Separate committed-source SD6 cold review with findings resolved.
- Named compiled mutations and independent accepting controls; compile-door witnesses clean both Compile and Test and prove both recompilations.
- Clean exact-candidate standalone provider compileAll/testAll, separate format checks, frozen S0 values and applicable WOG backend byte court.
- Executable docs examples for public API changes; exact-pinned storyatlas consumer suite when its dependencies or interfaces are touched.
- Local evidence and commits only; no push or scientific/CI qualification implied.

Scope limits:
- No new acquisition admission; full participant film-alignment proof stays on its existing later ticket.

Plan sections: §10.
set.title: [film] join Sherlock repair and composition to film compilation
